CustomField.description: Whether households emptied by deleting people are kept rather than moved to the Recycle Bin by the nightly tidy-up (R-H12a). Shipped false so the tidy-up is on, including on upgrade.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Keep a household after its people are deleted, instead of tidying it away once they cannot be restored.
CustomField.label: Keep Households of Deleted People
